skills.name: software-quality-review
skills.description: Assess a single component's code quality using ISO-25010 criteria. Infers purpose from code/docs, checks against project coding standards, and produces a structured quality report. Trigger: /quality <path>

skills.name: coding-practice-review
skills.description: Analyzes one or more source files against the project's coding practices defined in CODING_PRACTICES.md and produces a structured Markdown report with violations, suggestions, and severity. Trigger: /practice-review <file> [file2 ...]
